title: Current Challenges and Future Directions in Diffusion MRI: From Model- to Data-Driven Analysis
authors: Kurt G. Schilling, Baxter Rogers, Adam W. Anderson, Bennett A. Landman
journal: Computational Diffusion MRI, Mathematics and Visualization, pp. 63–78
summary: A perspective on the limits of diffusion MRI tissue models and tractography, and opportunities for data-driven analysis. It considers individual-level tissue characterization, learned representations, and harmonization.
description: This conference chapter examines challenges in diffusion MRI microstructural modeling and tractography and proposes directions for data-driven analysis. It discusses learning signal features, improving geometric modeling, and harmonizing measurements across datasets. The arguments are forward-looking proposals rather than a validated clinical workflow.
limitations: This perspective proposes directions for research; it does not report a validated clinical workflow.
